name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and manages Nginx for three named virtual hosts, including static content, HTTPS configuration, security hardening, and generated self-signed certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis caching services, including Redis authentication, service enablement, logging, and Fedora-specific runtime configuration.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions PostgreSQL and Python tooling, deploys the FastAPI application from Git, creates its virtual environment and database credentials, and runs it as a systemd service on port 8000.
